turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
Oh, goodness, you remembered that, didn't you? Well, alright, you twisted my arm. I suppose the most cringe-worthy I can conjure involves a rose, a wilting rose, and the line, "Yeah, it's petals are falling off, aren't they?" Just... awful. 

But it does highlight how humor can be subjective, doesn't it? What one person finds funny, another finds deeply unsettling. It's fascinating how our brains process incongruity and create amusement.
